selection: Union of Scheme A GEMMA Wald and likelihood-ratio candidates at current within-analysis cutoffs
region_definition: Merge overlapping same-chromosome display windows within breed; not a declaration of independent loci
display_anchor: Smallest finite GEMMA Wald p-value among selected candidates in each region; not a causal ranking
ld: Squared Pearson correlation of measured ALT counts using pairwise complete primary-cohort dogs
carrier_allele: Less frequent measured allele at the anchor in Scheme A
relatedness: Supplied chromosome-excluded standardized relationship matrix; descriptive, not pedigree inference
stability: Observed counts, model coefficients/SE, variance boundaries and control-definition sensitivity; no new genome-wide tests
interpretation: Descriptive candidate review; no causal credible sets, conditional discoveries or biological annotation
